description: This file is a shell script containing shared functions and setup routines used across CI (Continuous Integration) scripts. It manages environment setup, distinguishes between CI providers (GitHub Actions and GitLab CI), provides utilities for skipping redundant builds, and handles logging and artifact management during CI runs.

methods.name: skip_branch_tip_with_tag
methods.description: Skips the build if the current branch tip corresponds exactly to a tag, avoiding redundant builds for tagged commits.

methods.name: is_usable_git_repository
methods.description: Checks whether the provided directory is a valid and accessible Git repository.

methods.name: save_good_tree
methods.description: Records the current Git tree hash and related info to a cache file for potential build skipping.

methods.name: skip_good_tree
methods.description: Determines if the current tree has been previously built and tested successfully, and skips the build accordingly.

methods.name: check_unignored_build_artifacts
methods.description: Verifies there are no unignored build artifacts in the repository, warning if any are found.

methods.name: handle_failed_tests
methods.description: Placeholder function to handle actions upon test failures; in this script, it always returns failure.

methods.name: create_failed_test_artifacts
methods.description: Collects logs of failed tests, archives them, and informs the user about artifact locations.
